hypothesis: The current paired-scale3x3 regional tokens dilute small lesions and mix black padding with retinal evidence. Test7x7multiscale regional attention and foreground-weighted token pooling under matched M5 heads.
image_policy: Use only2091original training/validation cached images. No external raw images or scores. Global/mid/dispersion copied exactly from existing feature bank, so only local evidence changes.
foreground: From input pixels after fixed resize: maxRGB>20/255 AND green>10/255. Average to DINO patch grid then adaptively average to regional grid. Multi-scale occupancy is mean of the two scales. Valid if mean occupancy>0.2; if all invalid retain greatest occupancy region.
pooling: Ordinary features use adaptive average over patch tokens. Weighted features use adaptive_avg(token*patch_foreground_fraction)/adaptive_avg(patch_foreground_fraction), with unweighted fallback when denominator<=1e-6. Shared masks depend only on pixels. Cast tokens tofloat32for pooling and final regions tofloat16.
matched_control: OriginalM5same global/mid/dispersion,3x3unweighted tokens,no masks. Existing fixed M5 source models and original outer predictions preserved.
head_config: Exactly M5attention flat taxonomy hidden256/dropout0.6/lr0.002/wd0.1/aux0.8/smoothing0.03/fine_contrastive0.05;3seeds,120epochs,patience18. Same seed initializes all common parameters.
